scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly positive two-state symmetric switching with a stationary initial phase, one-dimensional Brownian generator D times the Laplacian, a fixed positive target distance, and reset-phase retention; establishes at least one crossover but not uniqueness, intermediate-distance ordering, or extension to nonstationary phases. Potential unindexed general Markov-modulated reset-FPT theorem remains a priority risk.
